# Design system

> A token-first React component library in Storybook, built as a portfolio case study by Tamir Said-Ahmed, Product Design Lead. The same 14 components are re-themed by tokens alone to carry different products.

## Where the substance is

- [Design principles](https://tamirsaidd.github.io/design-system/?path=/docs/docs-design-principles--docs): six rules and how each is enforced in code
- [Tokens](https://tamirsaidd.github.io/design-system/?path=/docs/docs-tokens--docs): every colour, type, spacing, radius, elevation and motion token, light and dark
- [Accessibility](https://tamirsaidd.github.io/design-system/?path=/docs/docs-accessibility--docs): contrast targets, focus, keyboard map, reduced motion, and how each is tested
- [Usage](https://tamirsaidd.github.io/design-system/?path=/docs/docs-usage--docs): running it, theming, chapter themes, proposing a component
- [Chapter 1, an education platform](https://tamirsaidd.github.io/design-system/?path=/docs/chapters-education-platform-intro--docs): three screens and a before/after, sample data only

## Source

- https://github.com/tamirsaidd/design-system
